name: MonarchAiConversationHeader
title: AiConversationHeader
wrapsNative: Menu with .menuStyle(.button) as the navigation title menu (placed in ToolbarItem(placement: .principal)), .alert with a TextField for Rename, ProgressView, MonarchAiAgentAvatar, AccessibilityNotification.Announcement
summary: The navigation-bar title of an AI conversation: the title with the assistant and model under it, as a title menu with Rename and the app's own actions.
whenToUse: At the top of an assistant conversation screen, in ToolbarItem(placement: .principal), when people should see which assistant and model answer and be able to rename the conversation or reach actions such as Share and Delete.
whenNotToUse: For a list of conversations use MonarchAiConversationList. For renaming a field inside a form use MonarchInlineEditText. For a plain screen title with no assistant use navigationTitle.
api: init(_ title: String, agent: MonarchAiAgentRef? = nil, model: String? = nil, isNaming: Bool = false, labels: MonarchAiConversationHeaderLabels = MonarchAiConversationHeaderLabels(), onRename: (@MainActor (String) async throws -> Void)? = nil, @ViewBuilder actions: () -> Actions)

init(_ title: String, agent: MonarchAiAgentRef? = nil, model: String? = nil, isNaming: Bool = false, labels: MonarchAiConversationHeaderLabels = MonarchAiConversationHeaderLabels(), onRename: (@MainActor (String) async throws -> Void)? = nil) where Actions == EmptyView
struct MonarchAiConversationHeaderLabels { init(untitled:, rename:, titleLabel:, save:, cancel:, naming:, agentPrefix:, modelPrefix:, renameFailed:, menuHint:) }

options.name: title
options.description: The conversation's title, trimmed. Empty shows "New conversation".

options.name: agent
options.description: The assistant answering; its decorative avatar and name show under the title.

options.name: model
options.description: The model in use, already localised, shown after the assistant.

options.name: isNaming
options.description: The title is being generated: shows "Naming conversation…" in the muted colour with a spinner and hides Rename.

options.name: onRename
options.description: Saves a new title, trimmed and changed. Adds Rename to the title menu. Throwing opens the prompt again with the draft and an error.

options.name: actions
options.description: The app's menu items after Rename, such as ShareLink, a model Picker and a destructive Delete button. Label it (actions:) when onRename is also given.

states.name: menu
states.description: With onRename or actions, the title is a menu button with a chevron.

states.name: plain
states.description: Without onRename and actions, the title is static header text.

states.name: naming
states.description: "Naming conversation…" in the muted text colour with a small spinner; Rename is hidden.

states.name: renaming
states.description: The system rename prompt with a text field holding the current title, Cancel and Save.

states.name: saving
states.description: The new title shows at once with a small spinner until onRename returns.

states.name: rename failed
states.description: The prompt opens again with the draft and "Couldn’t rename. Try again."; announced.

appearance: The title in the strong body style and the default text colour, centred, up to two lines; the assistant avatar, name and model in the caption style and the muted text colour; a muted chevron when it is a menu. Colours are theme roles, so light, dark and both high-contrast themes follow.
platformNotes: The web header is a bar with an inline text field for rename and a separate actions slot. On iPhone the title sits in the navigation bar, so the actions go in the system title menu and Rename uses the system prompt (an alert with a text field) instead of an inline editor; MonarchInlineEditText stays the form-field pattern. The web's model slot takes any view, such as an AiModelPicker; here model is text, and the model is changed with a Picker in the menu or a MonarchAiModelPicker in a toolbar item, because a menu cannot hold a sheet-presenting picker. The web's headingLevel has no iOS equivalent; the title has the header trait. Enter and Escape are keyboard behaviours of the web field; the prompt has Save and Cancel. Marked experimental as an AI product pattern until a Rook app adopts it. Android has no conversation header yet.
accessibility: The title has the header trait and is read with the assistant and model as its value, "AI assistant: Research agent. Model: Fast model", built by a tested pure function.
As a menu, the title is a button with the hint "Shows conversation actions".
The agent avatar is decorative because the name is written beside it.
Rename uses the system alert with a text field named "Conversation title", so VoiceOver and the keyboard behave as everywhere in iOS.
A failed rename is announced and shown in the reopened prompt.
The title area has at least a 44-point touch target and wraps to two lines at large text sizes.
edgeCases: An empty or unchanged title is not saved and onRename is not called.
A long title is truncated after two lines; the full title is still read by VoiceOver.
A blank model or agent name is left out of the line and the spoken value.
While isNaming is true, Rename is not offered even if onRename is given; the app actions stay.
